title: Clinic Risk Mix: 60 Patients in the High Tier
description: 60 of the clinic's 200 attributed patients now score high-risk across clinical, monitoring, social, and utilization signals. The tier distribution is trended per refresh, so the quality program sees the mix move before the measure period closes.

title: Care-Gap Closure Pace Against Open Work
description: 51 outreach tasks have closed while 80 remain open, so closure is running behind task creation. Each open task traces to a measure-set care gap, and the dashboard tracks closure through outreach to the booked, kept visit.

title: ED Utilization Concentrating in the Panel
description: 96 claims in the current window carry an ED flag. Cross-referenced with risk tiers and social-need screenings, the pattern concentrates in the same patients the outreach program is working — evidence the gap list is pointed at the right people.
